select t1.ctg_id as id, t1.ctg_name as name, t1.ctg_type as type, t1.ctg_desc as description, t1.sort_id as sortId, t1.ctg_parent_id as parentId, case when t1.created_by = #{userName} then 1 else 0 end as isAdmin, t1.created_by as createdBy, t1.updated_by as updatedBy, date_format(t1.created_time , '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdTime, date_format(t1.updated_time , '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedTime from ssd_query_template_ctg t1 where 1=1 and t1.is_active = 1 and t1.ctg_id not in ('fav', 'my','share', 'space') and t1.ctg_type not in ('space') and t1.created_by = #{userName} order by sortId asc, name asc

select space.space_ctg_id as spaceCtgId, max(space.owner_role) as ownerRole from ( select s1.space_ctg_id, s1.owner_id, s1.owner_role from ssd_query_template_space s1 where s1.owner_type = 'dept' and concat(#{deptId}, '/') like concat('%', s1.owner_id, '/%') union all select s2.space_ctg_id, s2.owner_id, s2.owner_role from ssd_query_template_space s2 where s2.owner_type = 'user' and s2.owner_id = #{userName} ) space group by space.space_ctg_id
